name: org.pipeforge/soul-almanac
title: Soul Almanac
description: Birth data in, measurements out: chart, Human Design, patterns, and a written birthday entry.

tools.name: birth_chart
tools.description: Compute a birth chart from a date, time and place. Returns a block of text containing natal placements, Human Design type and centres, chart patterns and a written entry for the birthday. The block carries its own instructions: interpret it, do not summarise it.

tob.description: Time of birth, HH:MM, or 'noon' / 'midnight'. Defaults to noon.

place.description: Birthplace as a human writes it, e.g. 'Springfield, Illinois, USA'

lat.description: Latitude, if known — use instead of place

lon.description: Longitude, if known — use instead of place

tz.description: IANA timezone, e.g. America/Chicago — required with lat and lon

tools.name: day_entry
tools.description: The written entry for one birthday, with its tags: sun sign, element, modality, decan, decan ruler, season and numerology. Describes a date, not a person.
